name: Remote Control and mobile
summary: Keep a session that runs on your computer going from your phone or a browser.
what: Remote Control lets you follow and steer a Claude Code session that runs on your own machine from claude.ai/code, the Claude mobile app or the desktop app. The code and files stay on your computer. The mobile app can also start and watch cloud sessions and send push notifications.

impact.title: Step away from the desk
impact.detail: Answer Claude's questions from your phone.

impact.title: Your setup stays local
impact.detail: Files, MCP servers and settings remain on your machine.

impact.title: Stays in sync
impact.detail: The conversation matches across terminal, browser and phone.

howItWorks: Run /remote-control in a session, or start with claude --remote-control.
Or run claude remote-control to serve new sessions from this machine.
Run /mobile to get a QR code for the Claude app.
Needs a claude.ai login; your computer must stay on.
Team and Enterprise owners must enable it.

events.note: First changelog mention of the claude remote-control command.
